title: A blocking gate classes the ops-row value shape 'phase token' as secrets
goal: A gate whose text says token only as the name of the ops-row value shape (a phase token, a closed token) is classed design, not secrets, so a worker's provisional gate on an ops row is not made blocking; a gate naming a credential, an API key or a bearer token stays secrets.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import bl_authority as a; c, _ = a.class_reasons({'touches': []}, {'id': 'g9', 'question': 'Which phase token does the ops row carry?', 'options': ['apply', 'record']}); sys.exit(c == 'secrets')
